meta.name: Send daily short-form video ideas to Discord from Google News RSS with Claude

parameters.content:
## Daily Content Ideas

### How it works
1. A daily schedule trigger fires once per day, by default at 7:00 AM.
2. The workflow fetches the latest AI-related news from a Google News RSS search.
3. A Code node deduplicates the items, drops anything older than 24 hours, and keeps the 15 newest stories.
4. Claude reviews the filtered stories, picks the 5 most viral-worthy ones, and writes a hook, angle, and full 30-45 second script for each.
5. A second Code node parses Claude's JSON response and formats it into Discord-ready messages, splitting across multiple messages if needed.
6. The formatted content ideas are posted to a Discord channel through an incoming webhook.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Add an Anthropic API credential to the "Generate Video Ideas (Claude)" node.
- [ ] Add your Discord webhook URL to the "Send to Discord" node.
- [ ] Edit the `q=` parameter in "Fetch News (RSS)" to match your content niche.
- [ ] Change the trigger hour in "Schedule Trigger" if 7:00 AM doesn't suit your schedule.

### Customization
Duplicate the RSS node with a different feed URL and add a Merge node before the Clean & Filter step to pull from multiple sources. Adjust the system prompt in the Claude node to change tone, script length, or the number of ideas generated per run.

## Daily schedule trigger
Runs once a day at a configurable time. Default is 7:00 AM — edit the hour inside this node's interval settings.

## Fetch AI news
Pulls the latest items from a Google News RSS search, which aggregates hundreds of outlets from one keyword. Edit the `q=` value in the URL to change niche, or duplicate this node with a different feed and add a Merge node.

## Clean and deduplicate news
Removes duplicate stories by link, drops anything older than 24 hours, and keeps only the 15 newest items for the AI step.

options.system: You are a viral short-form video content strategist for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. You have sharp news judgment and instantly know what will make people stop scrolling. Always respond with strict, valid JSON only - never wrap output in markdown code fences and never add explanatory text before or after the JSON.

values.content:
=Here are today's news items as a JSON array (each item has title, link, and summary):

{{ JSON.stringify($json.items) }}

From these, select the 5 stories most relevant and viral-worthy for short-form video content (TikTok / Instagram Reels / YouTube Shorts) in this niche.

For each of the 5 selected stories, produce:
- hook: a scroll-stopping opening line, under 15 words
- angle: the unique take or perspective the video will take, 1 sentence
- full_script: a complete 30-45 second spoken script, conversational, ready to read on camera, no stage directions or camera notes
- source_link: the original article URL for that story

Respond with ONLY a valid JSON array of exactly 5 objects, each with keys: hook, angle, full_script, source_link. No markdown, no code fences, no commentary before or after the JSON.

parameters.content:
## Generate video ideas with Claude
Picks the 5 most viral-worthy stories and writes a hook, angle, and full 30-45s script for each. Requires an Anthropic API credential on this node.

## Format ideas for Discord
Parses Claude's JSON response into a numbered message with each hook, angle, and script, splitting into multiple messages if it exceeds Discord's 2000-character limit.

## Post to Discord
Sends the formatted content idea(s) to a channel via an incoming webhook. Set your webhook URL in this node.
